verdict.rationale: Cactus documents cloud handoff ('Route hard queries to the cloud automatically'), but no pricing tiers, rate limits or usage caps are documented for that hosted inference. The published plans, the /v1/plans endpoint and the /billing limits all cover the hosted fine-tuning and training platform, a different capability that does not transfer to cloud inference offloading.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know the pricing tiers, rate limits, and usage caps that apply when offloading inference to the vendor's hosted cloud tier
